description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source testing management tool. It handles copying test plan assignments between builds, including initializing page context, permissions, and processing user actions for copying assignments.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic standard class used to create objects dynamically within the script.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes the request parameters and fetches related build and test plan information for processing.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Prepares the GUI elements for the page, including build selection info and messages.

methods.name: getBuildDomainForGUI
methods.description: Builds the HTML options for selecting a source build, including counts of current assignments.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for accessing and performing actions on the test plan.
